say:5:1511105003:0.text: Then the Wildborn may know peace once more.
say:5:1511105003:0.source_cn: 那么，雅库伯尔将不再面临威胁。

say:6:1511105004:0.text: But peace doesn't last forever. Without the goddess' protection... if the Halians return to war, how will we survive? *Cough*
say:6:1511105004:0.source_cn: 可是以后该怎么办？没了神的庇护，万一呼临人再次发动战争...

say:11:1511105005:0.text: Don't say that, Modra. The Wildborn still have you and Kordan.
say:11:1511105005:0.source_cn: 蒙多，雅库伯尔还有你和戈丹。

say:12:1511105006:0.text: Child, I know you mean well. But what the Wildborn need now isn't one person. It's <style="highlight">a faith strong enough to steady the tribe's heart</style>.
say:12:1511105006:0.source_cn: 老朽知道你想安慰大家，但雅库伯尔现在最需要的不是哪个人...

say:13:1511105007:0.text: With the Herdmaster gone, where do we go now?
say:13:1511105007:0.source_cn: 兽群之主陨落后，雅库伯尔要何去何从？！

say:14:1511105008:0.text:
... And there's still <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
He's stood by us this entire time.
say:14:1511105008:0.male:
... And there's still <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
He's stood by us this entire time.
say:14:1511105008:0.female:
... And there's still <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
She's stood by us this entire time.

say:15:1511105009:0.text: But he's no god, Gala! Why can't you understand...?
say:15:1511105009:0.male: But he's no god, Gala! Why can't you understand...?
say:15:1511105009:0.female: But she's no god, Gala! Why can't you understand...?

say:19:1511105010:0.source_cn: 人类的魔法师，雅库伯尔问你。

say:20:1511105011:0.text: Why did you impersonate the Hunting Goddess?
say:20:1511105011:0.male: Why did you impersonate the Hunting Goddess?
say:20:1511105011:0.female: Why did you impersonate the Hunting Goddess?

choice_prompt:21:1511105011.text: Why did you impersonate the Hunting Goddess?
choice_prompt:21:1511105011.male: Why did you impersonate the Hunting Goddess?
choice_prompt:21:1511105011.female: Why did you impersonate the Hunting Goddess?

say:24:1511105014:0.source_cn: 戈丹，这些都已经不重要……

say:25:1511105015:0.text: The goddess we served has abandoned us. The Blood Moon vanished, its blessings faded... and the people—
say:25:1511105015:0.source_cn: 雅库伯尔在象征神降与恩赐的血月，被忠心追随的神明背弃…...
say:25:1511105015:0.male: The goddess we served has abandoned us. The Blood Moon vanished, its blessings faded... and the people—
say:25:1511105015:0.female: The goddess we served has abandoned us. The Blood Moon vanished, its blessings faded... and the people—

say:26:1511105016:0.text: The people are afraid. Rumors have spread in Wrathwood Grove that this Blood Moon... was <style="highlight">an omen of disaster</style>.
say:26:1511105016:0.source_cn: 如今的树怒山谷，已经流传着<style=highlig...
say:26:1511105016:0.male: The people are afraid. Rumors have spread in Wrathwood Grove that this Blood Moon... was <style="highlight">an omen of disaster</style>.
say:26:1511105016:0.female: The people are afraid. Rumors have spread in Wrathwood Grove that this Blood Moon... was <style="highlight">an omen of disaster</style>.

say:27:1511105017:0.text: If this continues, the entire Wildborn tribe will fall into chaos!
say:27:1511105017:0.source_cn: 若再这样下去，只怕整个雅库伯尔都将陷入动荡！
say:27:1511105017:0.male: If this continues, the entire Wildborn tribe will fall into chaos!
say:27:1511105017:0.female: If this continues, the entire Wildborn tribe will fall into chaos!

say:31:1511105018:0.text: High Priestess, you need not worry so much.
say:31:1511105018:0.source_cn: 长老阁下，您无需这么忧虑。

say:32:1511105019:0.text: <style="highlight">The age of gods is coming to an end.</style> The future belongs not to deities—but to the Wildborn. To mortals.

say:34:1511105020:0.text: Bold words, Halian. But you don't know what will happen in the future.
say:34:1511105020:0.source_cn: 我不相信你，呼临人。你不知道未来会发生什么。

say:35:1511105021:1.text: One goddess has fallen. But others remain, and they are dangerous. If they choose to destroy us, they can.
say:35:1511105021:1.source_cn: 狩猎神陨落，但这世上依然有很多神明。只要他们想，轻易就...

say:36:1511105022:1.text: Please trust the judgment of the Arcane Council. Time will prove everything.
say:36:1511105022:1.source_cn: 请相信魔法师协会首席的判断。时间会验证一切。

say:37:1511105023:1.text: You will write your own story, free from divine chains. Pass on your honor, your strength, and your will to the generations to come.
say:37:1511105023:1.source_cn: 雅库伯尔有很长的路要走。但你们的荣耀与传统将会传承下去...
say:37:1511105023:1.male: You will write your own story, free from divine chains. Pass on your honor, your strength, and your will to the generations to come.
say:37:1511105023:1.female: You will write your own story, free from divine chains. Pass on your honor, your strength, and your will to the generations to come.

say:38:1511105024:1.source_cn: 不再仰赖神明，自己主宰命运……

say:39:1511105025:1.text: You promise us a vague future, mage.
say:39:1511105025:1.source_cn: 你许诺了一个缥缈的未来，魔法师。

say:40:1511105026:1.source_cn: 雅库伯尔现在还没法相信你。

say:41:1511105027:0.text: You don't need to believe in me. Believe in yourselves, Wildborn Chieftain.
say:41:1511105027:0.source_cn: 不必相信我，雅库伯尔的首领。你们只需要相信自己。
say:41:1511105027:0.male: You don't need to believe in me. Believe in yourselves, Wildborn Chieftain.
say:41:1511105027:0.female: You don't need to believe in me. Believe in yourselves, Wildborn Chieftain.

say:45:1511105029:0.text: Chieftain! Urgent news! The Halians! They're coming to Wrathwood Grove!
say:45:1511105029:0.source_cn: ——不好了！呼临人，呼临人来树怒山谷了！

say:46:1511105030:0.text: What? Do they still want to fight?!

choice:21:0:1.text: I did what the moment called for.
choice:21:0:1.male: I did what the moment called for.
choice:21:0:1.female: I did what the moment called for.

choice:21:1:2.text: If I hadn't, Gala would've died.
choice:21:1:2.source_cn: 不这么做的话，加拉就会死
choice:21:1:2.male: If I hadn't, Gala would've died.
choice:21:1:2.female: If I hadn't, Gala would've died.

say:48:1511105013:0.text: You really are different from the Hunting Goddess. We should have realized it sooner.
say:48:1511105013:0.source_cn: ……你果然和狩猎神不同。我们早该意识到。
say:48:1511105013:0.male: You really are different from the Hunting Goddess. We should have realized it sooner.
say:48:1511105013:0.female: You really are different from the Hunting Goddess. We should have realized it sooner.

choice:21:2:3.text: I didn't want to cause a conflict.
choice:21:2:3.source_cn: 我不想和你们产生矛盾
choice:21:2:3.male: I didn't want to cause a conflict.
choice:21:2:3.female: I didn't want to cause a conflict.

choice:4:1:2.text: She won't harm your people again.
choice:4:1:2.source_cn: 堕神不会再危害你们了
choice:4:1:2.male: She won't harm your people again.
choice:4:1:2.female: She won't harm your people again.
